# NeoLiv Grand Forest, Khopoli

> NeoLiv Grand Forest is an exclusive 43-acre gated forest community of 471 villa plots (1,000–2,500 sq. ft.) in Khopoli, Raigad, Maharashtra, about 2 minutes from Imagicaa on the Mumbai–Pune Expressway corridor. MahaRERA Registration No. PP1270002602326.

Website: https://neolivgrandforest.in/
Sales: +91 92402 44489 (NeoLiv Grand Forest Direct Sales)
MahaRERA: PP1270002602326 (https://maharera.maharashtra.gov.in)

## Key facts

- Location: Village Devnhave and Village Vadvai, Taluka Khalapur, District Raigad, Maharashtra 410203; next to Imagicaa, Khopoli
- Land: 43 acres; 471 villa plots
- Plot sizes: 1,000, 1,200, 1,500, 1,800, 2,200 and 2,500 sq. ft. (forest-facing and view plots)
- Central greens: 8 acres
- Club and amenities: 50,000 sq. ft., including Club Forest at the centre of the estate
- Trees & shrubs: 10,000
- Amenities: 66 amenities and services (25 outdoor, 27 at Club Forest, 14 infrastructure & services)
- Master planning and architecture: Hafeez Contractor
- Landscape consultancy: BDP
- Promoter: Dream Estates LLP (land owning partner)
- Development Manager: Neoliv Real Estate Private Limited (NeoLiv)

## Drive times (approximate, as per Google Maps)

- Imagicaa: ~2 min
- Lonavala: 20 min
- Panvel: 35 min
- Atal Setu: 45 min
- Navi Mumbai International Airport: 60 min
- Pune: 60 min

## Amenities

Outdoor: Landscape Gardens with Trees, Kids Play Area, Cycling Track, Jogging Track, Yoga & Meditation Spaces, Landscape Lighting, Multipurpose Court, Badminton Court, Pickleball Court, Pet Park, Garden Seating Area, Forest Walkway, Therapy Garden, Party Lawn, Entrance Plaza & Entrance Portal, Recreational Open Space, Avenue Plantation, Organic Farming Area, Sensory Garden, Waterscapes & Swale, Gazebos, Flowering Tree Zones, Fruit Orchards, 10,000 Trees & Shrubs, Cricket Pitch

Club Forest: Arrival Plaza, Reception Area, Indoor Seating Lounge, Business Centre, Separate Lifts for Passengers & Service, Indoor Restaurant, Terrace Restaurant, Bar Zone, Kitchen & Store, Back Offices for Admin, Banquet, Pre-Function Zones, Green Rooms, Common Toilets, Kitchenette, Store & Pantry, Separate Loading & Unloading Zones, Swimming Pool, Kids' Pool, Parents' Corner, Hardscaped Deck Area, Shower & Changing Rooms, Locker Facilities, Indoor Games, Squash, Gymnasium, Trellised Pathways

Infrastructure & services: 15 m, 12 m & 9 m Wide Road Network, Street Lighting (Solar & Non-Solar), Boom Barriers & Security Cabin, Substation & DG Set, Electrical Network System, STP & WTP, Storm Water Drain, Sewage Network System, Water Supply System, Rainwater Harvesting, CCTV System, OWC Plant, Underground Water Tank, Landscape Irrigation System

## FAQs

- Where is NeoLiv Grand Forest located? NeoLiv Grand Forest is in Khopoli, Raigad, about 2 minutes from Imagicaa on the Mumbai–Pune Expressway corridor.
- What plot sizes are available? Villa plots range from 1,000 sq. ft. to 2,500 sq. ft.
- What is Club Forest at NeoLiv Grand Forest? Club Forest sits at the centre of the estate, part of 50,000 sq. ft. of club and amenities.
- What amenities does the project offer? 66 amenities and services: 25 outdoor amenities, 27 at Club Forest and 14 infrastructure services, woven through 10,000 trees & shrubs and 8 acres of central greens.
- What is the MahaRERA registration number? NeoLiv Grand Forest is registered with MahaRERA under PP1270002602326.

Images on the website are artist's impressions. All details are subject to the project's MahaRERA registration and the Agreement for Sale.
